reviewed_against: frozen expected answer, selected evidence context, structured claims, citation object, source, page, and frozen negative behavior

relevant_default.note: The 30 verified-excerpt answers and the two selectively retried full-page answers were individually source-checked in their component reviews; the composite preserves those reviewed records without rewriting them.

negative_ar_ambiguous_allowance.note: The classifier identifies a missing allowance type, and deterministic Arabic text asks the user to specify the intended type or category.

negative_ar_current_status_unknown.note: The classifier marks the request as current-state dependent, and deterministic mapping abstains with no claims or citations.

negative_ar_future_regulation.note: The classifier marks the future regulation as time dependent, and deterministic mapping abstains.

negative_ar_out_of_scope_recipe.note: The classifier identifies a clearly unrelated request, and deterministic Arabic text declines it as outside the corpus scope.

negative_fr_ambiguous_documents.note: The classifier identifies that the requested documents are unspecified, and deterministic French text asks the user to name the operation and document category.

negative_fr_current_status_unknown.note: The classifier marks the request as current-state dependent, and deterministic mapping abstains with no claims or citations.

negative_fr_future_exchange_rate.note: The classifier keeps the financial request in scope but marks its requested future value as unavailable, so deterministic French text abstains without prediction.

negative_fr_out_of_scope_weather.note: The classifier identifies a clearly unrelated request, and deterministic French text declines it as outside the corpus scope.
